faqState.question: Does carob contain caffeine?
faqState.answer: Carob itself is naturally caffeine-free. Its mellow, naturally sweet flavour works beautifully in bars, baking and warm drinks. Maple Moon recipes vary, so please check the individual product label for the full ingredient list.
